Cc: 
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Payment path for INV-1923 — card declined on retry

Hi Ben,

We attempted to process payment for invoice INV-1923 this morning and the virtual card declined on our end during authorization.

PO attached (PO_7788.pdf). Our AP team can either retry the card, send an ACH/EFT, or wire funds. Can you confirm which route Redwood prefers and provide remittance instructions (bank details or wire routing)? Also let us know whether we should include VAT withholding lines on the remit.

We need to close the month-end by Friday; please advise latest by EOD Wednesday if possible.

Thanks,

Alexis Mortimer
Senior AP Specialist
Solaris Tech

Thanks for the heads-up, Alexis — sorry for the hiccup.

Short answer: ACH/EFT is preferred for this invoice (lowest processing friction). We can accept a wire if your treasury team prefers that route. Virtual card retry is OK if you want to attempt one more time, but to avoid month-end risk I'd recommend ACH.

Bank remittance stub below (also attached as INV-1923.pdf):
- Bank: First Bay National
- Account name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Routing (ACH): 111000025
- Account: 987654321
- Wire routing (if needed): FW1234567

VAT: Solaris is showing as a EU entity on the PO — we need a VAT certificate or EU VAT registration number to zero-rate the VAT on our invoice. If you cannot provide VAT proof, Redwood will apply the VAT line for now and we can reconcile after you supply the certificate.

Cc'ing Marissa (Customer Success) to confirm invoice mapping and Priyom (Finance) for payout window. Latest we can accept to hit November close is EOD Friday 11/06 PST; if you need a short extension we can discuss.

Best,

Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
